context.transcript:
Thanks for listening to KQSP Radio.
Remember to tune in next Saturday evening for our 10th anniversary celebration.
We'll be playing the top 10 songs of the past decade selected by you, the listeners.
There's still time to vote for your favorite song.
You can do that by sending a text message to 5143.
The songs with the most votes will be played during our show next Saturday evening.
And coming up after a short break, we've got a live in-studio interview with pop singer Ezra Ortiz.
He'll be telling us about his upcoming world tour.

我们将播放由各位听众选出的过去十年十大歌曲。
现在仍然可以为你最喜欢的歌曲投票。
发送短信至 5143 即可投票。
得票最多的歌曲将在下周六晚上的节目中播放。
短暂休息之后，我们将在演播室对流行歌手 Ezra Ortiz 进行现场直播访谈。
他将向我们介绍即将开始的世界巡演。
